onboarding.schedule-step-description: Make your work productive and comfortable! Easily customize your schedule for personal goals and customer desires! Change work days and weekends: a special schedule will help you with this!
onboarding.service-step-description: Add new services, set their duration and form the schedule of your day!
onboarding.customer-step-description: You can add a customer manually or import from your contact list. Add notes for the client to mark their uniqueness. And remember: the customer is always right!
onboarding.reservation-step-description: The first reservation is always exciting! All reservations will be displayed on the main board, so you can always see your busyness and easily make changes to the schedule!
onboarding.site-step-description: With the help of the site, clients will be able to book themselves, based on your schedule. You can add photos, address, links to social networks. Personal website is a paid service, the first month is free. To renew the service, go to the settings -> my subscriptions.
onboarding.finish-step-header: Everything is ready to start. Good luck!
